question: What was our total revenue last quarter?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM s_order_items AS oi
JOIN s_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND oi.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 QUARTER), QUARTER)
  AND oi.created_at <  DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), QUARTER)
LIMIT 100
report: Net revenue for the quarter. Stated as net because cancelled and returned orders are excluded; the gross figure runs about a third higher and is not what the board tracks.
